title: Smooth morphisms
statement:
A morphism of schemes $f:X\to Y$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] is *smooth* if it is locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] and formally smooth [def-sbc-formally-smooth], the latter meaning that for every first order thickening $T\subset T'$ of affine schemes over $Y$ [def-sbc-first-order-thickening] and every morphism $T\to X$ over $Y$ there is a morphism $T'\to X$ over $Y$ whose restriction to $T$ is the given one ([Stacks Project, Definition 37.11.1](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02H0)); by [Lemma 37.11.7](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02H6) this is the notion of a smooth morphism of [Stacks Project, Section 29.35](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01V4), defined there affine-locally by smooth ring maps.

Let $n\geq0$ be an integer. A smooth morphism $f:X\to Y$ is *smooth of relative dimension $n$ at a point* $x\in X$ if the fibre $X_{f(x)}=X\times_Y\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(f(x))$ [def-pc-base-change] through $x$ has dimension $n$ at $x$, that is $\dim_x\bigl(X_{f(x)}\bigr)=n$ [def-kun-dimension]; $f$ is *smooth of relative dimension $n$* if it is smooth and this holds at every point $x\in X$. (For a smooth morphism the function $x\mapsto\dim_x(X_{f(x)})$ is locally constant, [Stacks Project, Lemma 29.35.12](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02G1), so this is the notion of [Stacks Project, Definition 29.35.11](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02G2): $f$ smooth with all nonempty fibres equidimensional of dimension $n$.) An *etale* morphism is a smooth morphism of relative dimension zero.

split_report.summary: Repaired the garbled statement from Stacks Tag 02H0 (the blueprint source is the only copy; the parent commit's LaTeX and slopmaster2 have no definition): removed the duplicated clause 'smooth morphisms by flatness and smooth fibres is ... a criterion stated below' (a pointer to sbc-lem-smooth-criterion, which depends on this node, not a dependency) and the duplicated 'being'; replaced the blueprint's gloss of formal smoothness (extension Zariski-locally on T' for a nilpotent ideal, which is not what Tag 02H0 says) by the Stacks text (lifting against first order thickenings of affine schemes); restored the dangling 'A fibre through that point has dimension n' as the definition of 'smooth of relative dimension n at x' via dim_x of the fibre X_{f(x)}, with Tags 02G1/02G2 cited for the agreement with Stacks; kept the etale clause. Statement dependencies: scheme conventions, locally of finite presentation (new, Mathlib leaf), formally smooth (new, unsplit), first order thickening (new, unsplit), fibre (def-pc-base-change), dimension at a point (def-kun-dimension). Mathlib has AlgebraicGeometry.Smooth / SmoothOfRelativeDimension / Etale for the same notions, by the affine-local (Tag 01V5) definition; recorded as a match of the notion, with the equivalence Tag 02H6 noted.

lean.note: Reuse the existing notions, not new predicates: Smooth and SmoothOfRelativeDimension are in Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.Smooth; Etale is in Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.Etale. Etale.iff_smoothOfRelativeDimension_zero identifies the final clause. No node statement or dependencies changed; the duplicate sandbox module was removed in the second reading.
